additional_info.subject: ID0431307-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / P3 170000429] Charger is offline and stuck at %33 CRM:02681000329
additional_info.body:
Hi Furkan,
I checked this charger and we have a problem with KF11, I still can't see the charger online, but it must be able to come online in failsafemode.
Can you please check on-site the possibility to reboot and bring it at least online? Also, if it's possible check the Ethernet cables to KF11 and see if there is no loose connection or change to a different switch port.
If the KF11 comes online, I can mitigate the coap polling without replacement.
Let me know your thoughts.
Best regards,
Francisco
